features: themed timeline, project library, auto-save, undo/redo
trim/split/duplicate/reorder; rotate/flip/zoom/pan and eased zoom motion
timed wrapped styled text; four mixed sound tracks and volume/fades
foreground paused composition preview and H.264/AAC MP4 export

validation.native_ui_review: Timeline and Text native screens inspected; snapshots internal only
validation.lint_exemption: WriteNativeEditor intentionally uses platform EditText in ComponentActivity; scoped AppCompatCustomView exemption after Lottie introduced transitive AppCompat

limits: one video/photo lane; timed text and up to four sound tracks
no automatic captions, AI cutout, cloud templates, arbitrary video overlays or recording
fades through black, no overlapping crossfade
phone_notes: GPU composition preview, real codecs/export/provider, touch/keyboard and long-file performance require handset testing.
